name: Spaghetti Bolognese

components.name: Bolognese Sauce
steps: Finely dice the onion and garlic; have the canned tomato and stock measured before switching on the heat.
Heat oil in a deep pan over medium-high. Sweat the onion until translucent, then stir in garlic for about 30 seconds.
Increase the heat and brown the beef in a thin layer, breaking it into small pieces. If doubling the batch, brown in two rounds.
Pour in stock and scrape up the savoury bits. Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, Worcestershire, bouillon, bay, thyme, seasoning and optional sugar.
Simmer partially uncovered for 25–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick but still spoonable. Remove the bay leaves.

components.name: Spaghetti
steps: Boil spaghetti until just under al dente. Drain, reserving a little pasta water. Toss pasta with some sauce for meals going into the fridge; for freezer portions pack sauce separately from pasta.
Portion into five containers. Reheat thoroughly; loosen thick sauce with a splash of water.
